en.text: I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever.

zhSimplified.text: 我要歌唱耶和华的慈爱，直到永远；

zhTraditional.text: 我要歌唱耶和華的慈愛，直到永遠；

en.text: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

zhSimplified.text: 因我曾说：慈悲必建立到永远；

zhTraditional.text: 因我曾說：慈悲必建立到永遠；

en.text: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

zhSimplified.text: 我与我所拣选的人立了约， 起了誓：

zhTraditional.text: 我與我所揀選的人立了約， 起了誓：

en.text: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’”

zhSimplified.text: 我要建立你的后裔，直到永远；

zhTraditional.text: 我要建立你的後裔，直到永遠；

en.text: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，诸天要称赞你的奇事；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，諸天要稱讚你的奇事；

en.text: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,

zhSimplified.text: 在天空谁能比耶和华呢？

zhTraditional.text: 在天空誰能比耶和華呢？

en.text: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

zhSimplified.text: 他在圣者的会中，是大有威严的 神，

zhTraditional.text: 他在聖者的會中，是大有威嚴的上帝，

en.text: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.

footnotes.text: 89:8 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华—万军之 神啊，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華－萬軍之上帝啊，

en.text: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

zhSimplified.text: 你管辖海的狂傲；

zhTraditional.text: 你管轄海的狂傲；

en.text: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

zhSimplified.text: 你打碎了，似乎是已杀的人；

zhTraditional.text: 你打碎了，似乎是已殺的人；

en.text: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. have founded them.

zhSimplified.text: 天属你，地也属你；

zhTraditional.text: 天屬你，地也屬你；

en.text: You have created the north and the south. and Hermon rejoice in your name.

zhSimplified.text: 南北为你所创造； 和都因你的名欢呼。

zhTraditional.text: 南北為你所創造； 和都因你的名歡呼。

en.text: You have a mighty arm. hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

zhSimplified.text: 你有大能的膀臂；

zhTraditional.text: 你有大能的膀臂；

en.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. and truth go before your face.

zhSimplified.text: 公义和公平是你宝座的根基；

zhTraditional.text: 公義和公平是你寶座的根基；

en.text: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 知道欢呼的，那民是有福的！

zhTraditional.text: 知道歡呼的，那民是有福的！

en.text: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

zhSimplified.text: 他们因你的名终日欢乐，

zhTraditional.text: 他們因你的名終日歡樂，

en.text: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

zhSimplified.text: 你是他们力量的荣耀；

zhTraditional.text: 你是他們力量的榮耀；

en.text: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

zhSimplified.text: 我们的盾牌属耶和华； 的圣者。

zhTraditional.text: 我們的盾牌屬耶和華； 的聖者。

en.text: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

zhSimplified.text: 当时，你在异象中晓谕你的圣民，说：

zhTraditional.text: 當時，你在異象中曉諭你的聖民，說：

en.text: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

zhSimplified.text: 我寻得我的仆人，

zhTraditional.text: 我尋得我的僕人，

en.text: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

zhSimplified.text: 我的手必使他坚立；

zhTraditional.text: 我的手必使他堅立；

en.text: No enemy will tax him. will oppress him.

zhSimplified.text: 仇敌必不勒索他；

zhTraditional.text: 仇敵必不勒索他；

en.text: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

zhSimplified.text: 我要在他面前打碎他的敌人，

zhTraditional.text: 我要在他面前打碎他的敵人，

en.text: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

zhSimplified.text: 只是我的信实和我的慈爱要与他同在；

zhTraditional.text: 只是我的信實和我的慈愛要與他同在；

en.text: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

zhSimplified.text: 我要使他的手伸到海上，

zhTraditional.text: 我要使他的手伸到海上，

en.text: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

zhSimplified.text: 他要称呼我说：你是我的父，

zhTraditional.text: 他要稱呼我說：你是我的父，

en.text: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

zhSimplified.text: 我也要立他为长子，

zhTraditional.text: 我也要立他為長子，

en.text: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

zhSimplified.text: 我要为他存留我的慈爱，直到永远；

zhTraditional.text: 我要為他存留我的慈愛，直到永遠；

en.text: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

zhSimplified.text: 我也要使他的后裔存到永远，

zhTraditional.text: 我也要使他的後裔存到永遠，

en.text: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

zhSimplified.text: 倘若他的子孙离弃我的律法，

zhTraditional.text: 倘若他的子孫離棄我的律法，

en.text: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

zhSimplified.text: 背弃我的律例，

zhTraditional.text: 背棄我的律例，

en.text: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

zhSimplified.text: 我就要用杖责罚他们的过犯，

zhTraditional.text: 我就要用杖責罰他們的過犯，

en.text: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, my faithfulness to fail.

zhSimplified.text: 只是我必不将我的慈爱全然收回，

zhTraditional.text: 只是我必不將我的慈愛全然收回，

en.text: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

zhSimplified.text: 我必不背弃我的约，

zhTraditional.text: 我必不背棄我的約，

en.text: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

zhSimplified.text: 我一次指着自己的圣洁起誓： 说谎！

zhTraditional.text: 我一次指着自己的聖潔起誓： 說謊！

en.text: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

zhSimplified.text: 他的后裔要存到永远；

zhTraditional.text: 他的後裔要存到永遠；

en.text: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.”

zhSimplified.text: 又如月亮永远坚立，

zhTraditional.text: 又如月亮永遠堅立，

en.text: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

zhSimplified.text: 但你恼怒你的受膏者，

zhTraditional.text: 但你惱怒你的受膏者，

en.text: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

zhSimplified.text: 你厌恶了与仆人所立的约，

zhTraditional.text: 你厭惡了與僕人所立的約，

en.text: You have broken down all his hedges. have brought his strongholds to ruin.

zhSimplified.text: 你拆毁了他一切的篱笆，

zhTraditional.text: 你拆毀了他一切的籬笆，

en.text: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

zhSimplified.text: 凡过路的人都抢夺他；

zhTraditional.text: 凡過路的人都搶奪他；

en.text: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

zhSimplified.text: 你高举了他敌人的右手；

zhTraditional.text: 你高舉了他敵人的右手；

en.text: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

zhSimplified.text: 你叫他的刀剑卷刃，

zhTraditional.text: 你叫他的刀劍捲刃，

en.text: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

zhSimplified.text: 你使他的光辉止息，

zhTraditional.text: 你使他的光輝止息，

en.text: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame.

zhSimplified.text: 你减少他青年的日子，

zhTraditional.text: 你減少他青年的日子，

en.text: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，这要到几时呢？

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，這要到幾時呢？

en.text: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

zhSimplified.text: 求你想念我的时候是何等的短少；

zhTraditional.text: 求你想念我的時候是何等的短少；

en.text: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol?

footnotes.text: 89:48 Sheol is the place of the dead.

zhSimplified.text: 谁能常活免死、

zhTraditional.text: 誰能常活免死、

en.text: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，你从前凭你的信实 立誓要施行的慈爱在哪里呢？

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，你從前憑你的信實 立誓要施行的慈愛在哪裏呢？

en.text: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

zhSimplified.text: 主啊，求你记念仆人们所受的羞辱， 存在我怀里。

zhTraditional.text: 主啊，求你記念僕人們所受的羞辱， 存在我懷裏。

en.text: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，你的仇敌用这羞辱羞辱了你的仆人，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，你的仇敵用這羞辱羞辱了你的僕人，

en.text: Blessed be the LORD forever more. and Amen.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华是应当称颂的，直到永远。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華是應當稱頌的，直到永遠。
